.photo-item .rm { position: absolute; top: 7px; inset-inline-end: 7px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.6); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 26px; height: 26px; cursor: pointer; }
/* ✎ REWORDS THE COMMENT. It used to be a pencil glyph inside the caption line,
   which measured ten pixels across — a mouse can hit that, a thumb cannot, and
   that is why rewording only ever worked on the desktop. It is now a corner
   button of the same size as ✕, and the caption line itself opens the same
   dialog. Both grow on a phone, where they are pressed with a finger. */
.photo-item .ed { position: absolute; top: 7px; inset-inline-end: 39px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.6); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 26px; height: 26px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; padding: 0; }
.photo-item .cap[data-edcap] { cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.photo-item .cap .cap-pen { margin-inline-start: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--green-d, #0f766e);
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
/* non-image attachments (PDF / Excel / other) render as a download card */
.photo-item.file-item .file-link { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 124px; padding: 10px; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #1f2937); background: var(--green-l, #f1f5f9); }
.photo-item.file-item .file-icon { font-size: 38px; line-height: 1; }
.photo-item.file-item .file-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; word-break: break-word; max-height: 32px; overflow: hidden; }

.toolbar { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.toolbar input, .toolbar select { padding: 9px 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; font-family: inherit; background: #fff; }

/* modal */
.modal-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,31,46,.5); backdrop-filter: blur(3px); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding: 44px 16px; z-index: 50; overflow:auto; }
.modal { background: #fff; border-radius: 18px; width: 100%; max-width: 640px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); animation: pop .18s ease; }
/* Google Places autocomplete dropdown must float above the modal overlay (z-index 50). */
.pac-container { z-index: 10000; }
/* Per-site breakdown rows under a contract in the contracts list. */
.ct-sites-detail td { background: var(--bg, #f7f9fb); padding: 0 14px 10px; }
.ct-sites-detail table { width: 100%; margin: 0; }
.ct-sites-detail th, .ct-sites-detail td { font-size: 12.5px; padding: 5px 8px; }
@keyframes pop { from { transform: scale(.96) translateY(8px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } }
.modal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 18px 22px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.modal-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; }
.modal-body { padding: 22px; }

.toast { position: fixed; bottom: 26px; inset-inline-end: 26px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; padding: 13px 20px; border-radius: 12px; z-index: 100; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); font-weight: 600; animation: pop .2s ease; }
.empty { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); padding: 32px; }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 9px 18px; }
.kv div:nth-child(odd){ color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
/* Picked wording (condition / recommendations) reads as a numbered list. */
.wording-list { margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 20px; }
.wording-list li { line-height: 1.7; padding-inline-start: 2px; }
.section-title { display:flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items:center; margin: 22px 0 12px; }
.section-title h3 { margin:0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; }
.breadcrumb { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; display: inline-block; }
.breadcrumb:hover { color: var(--green-d); }

/* notifications bell */
.bell-wrap { position: relative; }
.bell-badge { position: absolute; top: -4px; inset-inline-end: -4px; background: var(--red); color: #fff; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 10px; min-width: 17px; height: 17px; line-height: 17px; text-align: center; padding: 0 3px; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff; }
.bell-menu { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 0; top: 38px; width: 330px; max-height: 440px; overflow: auto; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); z-index: 40; }
.bell-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 13px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.notif { padding: 12px 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; }
.notif:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
.notif.unread { background: var(--green-l); }
.notif .nt { font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; }

/* calendar */
.cal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 7px; }
.cal-grid.head { margin-bottom: 7px; }
.cal-dow { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; padding: 4px; }
.cal-cell { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; min-height: 98px; padding: 7px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.cal-cell.empty-cell { background: transparent; border: none; box-shadow: none; }
.cal-cell.today { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--green-l) inset; }
.cal-day { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
.cal-ev { font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 6px; margin-bottom: 4px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; font-weight: 600; }
.cal-ev-site { display: block; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.85; font-size: 10px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* Editable report document (Reports sidebar only) */
.rdoc { max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6ecf2; border-radius: 14px; padding: 26px 30px; box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.05); }
.rdoc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 2px solid #0f172a; padding-bottom: 12px; }
.rdoc-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.rdoc-no { color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 3px; }
.rdoc-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 24px; margin: 16px 0 8px; }
.rdoc-meta > div { font-size: 13px; }
.rdoc-meta span { color: #64748b; display: block; font-size: 11px; }
/* start / end / duration sit together on one line of their own */
.rdoc-meta .times { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 24px; }
.rdoc-sec { margin: 22px 0 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #0f172a; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e8ec; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.rdoc-body { margin-top: 12px; }
.rdoc-row { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.rdoc-row label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #64748b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.rdoc-row input, .rdoc-row textarea, .rdoc-row select { width: 100%; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #dfe6ee; border-radius: 8px; font: inherit; background: #fbfdff; }
.rdoc-row textarea { resize: vertical; }
.rdoc-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; }
.rdoc-table th, .rdoc-table td { padding: 8px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f5; text-align: start; }
.rdoc-table th { background: #f1f5f9; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #475569; }
/* Device follow-up (QR scan) + photos sections on the report document. */
.rdoc-extra { margin-top: 6px; }
.rdoc-fu { margin: 6px 0 14px; overflow-x: auto; }
.rdoc-fu h4 { margin: 10px 0 2px; font-size: 13px; color: #0f766e; }
.rdoc-fu .rdoc-table th, .rdoc-fu .rdoc-table td { white-space: nowrap; }
.rdoc-sigs { display: flex; gap: 30px; margin-top: 26px; }
.rdoc-sig { flex: 1; text-align: center; }
/* a photographed paper signature needs more room than a finger scribble,
   and max-width:100% keeps it inside its column on any paper size */
.rdoc-sig img { max-height: 110px; max-width: 100%; }
.rdoc-sig .ln { border-top: 1px solid #1c2733; margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 6px; color: #64748b; font-size: 12px; }

/* analytics bars */
.bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.bar-label { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; }
.bar-track { background: #eef2f6; border-radius: 8px; height: 18px; overflow: hidden; }
.bar-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 8px; min-width: 3px; transition: width .4s ease; background: var(--brand-grad); }
.bar-val { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; min-width: 64px; text-align: end; }

/* line items editor */
.li-table input { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.li-table td, .li-table th { padding: 6px 7px; }

/* ---------- site maps + markers ---------- */
.map-thumbs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.map-thumb { position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s; }
.map-thumb:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.map-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 124px; object-fit: cover; display: block; background: #f1f5f9; }
.map-thumb .mt-meta { padding: 9px 11px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.map-thumb .rm { position: absolute; top: 7px; inset-inline-end: 7px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 24px; height: 24px; cursor: pointer; }
.toolbar-select { padding: 8px 11px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; font-family: inherit; background: #fff; }

.map-legend-bar { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 11px 15px; background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.map-legend-bar .lg { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-weight: 600; }
.map-legend-bar .dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }

.map-stage { position: relative; display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow); background: #f1f5f9; }
.map-stage img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
.map-stage.placing { cursor: crosshair; }
.map-stage.placing .map-pin { pointer-events: none; opacity: .65; }
.map-pin {
  position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--mc);
  border-radius: 18px; padding: 2px 8px 2px 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
  cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap;
  transition: transform .12s;
}
.map-pin:hover { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.12); z-index: 5; }
.map-pin .pin-ic { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; }
.map-pin .pin-lbl { font-weight: 800; color: var(--mc); }

/* ---------- charts ---------- */
.chart-legend { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.chart-legend .lg, .pie-legend .lg { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-weight: 600; }
.sw { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; }

/* 3D tilted pie */
.pie3d-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pie3d-stage { perspective: 700px; padding: 26px 10px 34px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.pie3d {
  width: 180px; height: 180px; border-radius: 50%; transform: rotateX(58deg);
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: 0 22px 26px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.45), 0 14px 0 0 rgba(0,0,0,.16);
}
.pie3d::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 22px rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25); }
.pie-legend { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.pie-legend .lg { color: var(--ink); }

/* 3D cylinder columns */
.cols3d { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-around; gap: 16px; padding: 8px 4px 0; overflow-x: auto; }
.col3d-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-width: 56px; }
.col3d-bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; }
.col3d {
  width: 46px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cl), var(--c));
  border-radius: 7px 7px 5px 5px; position: relative; min-height: 4px; transition: height .5s ease;
  box-shadow: inset -8px 0 13px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 7px 6px 14px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}
.col3d-cap { position: absolute; top: -8px; inset-inline-start: 0; inset-inline-end: 0; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; filter: brightness(1.15); }
.col3d-val { font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 7px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink); }
.col3d-lbl { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; max-width: 80px; font-weight: 600; }

/* FoxSystems branding (app chrome) */
.brand-logo { width: 240px; max-width: 90%; height: auto; margin: 2px auto 14px; display: block; }
.brand-sm { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; }
.brand-logo-sm { width: 152px; max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.powered { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .02em; text-align: center; }
.powered-sm { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 10.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.5); letter-spacing: .02em; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .brand-logo-sm { width: 44px; } .powered-sm { display: none; } }

/* Dark navy login card — matches the FoxSystems logo so it blends in. */
.login-card {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0e2c42 0%, #0b2236 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); color: #e7eef5;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.login-card h1 { color: #f3f7fb; }
.login-card label { color: #c4d2df; }
.login-card .muted, .login-hint, .powered { color: #93a6b9; }
.login-card input {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.14); color: #eaf1f7;
}
.login-card input::placeholder { color: #7f93a6; }
.login-card input:focus { border-color: #2dd4bf; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,212,191,.18); }
.login-card .link-btn { color: #5eead4; }
.login-card .link-btn:hover { color: #99f6e4; }
/* Navy sidebar to match the FoxSystems theme (was green). */
.sidebar { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0e2c42 0%, #0a2236 55%, #07182a 100%); color: #aac1d4; }
.nav-item.active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e6fd6, #0ea5b7); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(14,116,144,.45); }
.sidebar-foot .link-btn { color: #7fc6dd; }
.sidebar-foot .link-btn:hover { color: #fff; }
.sidebar-foot .muted { color: #8aa0b4; }
/* Cohesive dark-blue backdrop to match the FoxSystems brand. */
.login-screen {
  background: radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 10% 0%, #14507a 0%, transparent 50%),
              radial-gradient(1000px 700px at 100% 100%, #0e7490 0%, transparent 55%),
              linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2236, #06141f);
}
.login-screen::before { background: #38bdf8; }
.login-screen::after { background: #22d3ee; }

/* Same backdrop, now gently animated: the gradient slowly drifts and the two
   blurred blobs float around. Honors reduced-motion. */
.login-screen {
  background-size: 180% 180%, 180% 180%, 100% 100%;
  animation: loginDrift 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes loginDrift {
  0%   { background-position: 0% 0%, 100% 100%, 0 0; }
  100% { background-position: 35% 25%, 65% 75%, 0 0; }
}
.login-screen::before { will-change: transform, opacity; animation: blobA 15s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.login-screen::after  { will-change: transform, opacity; animation: blobB 19s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes blobA {
  0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);       opacity: .20; }
  50%  { transform: translate(70px, 50px) scale(1.18); opacity: .33; }
  100% { transform: translate(25px, 100px) scale(1.06); opacity: .26; }
}
@keyframes blobB {
  0%   { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);        opacity: .20; }
  50%  { transform: translate(-60px, -35px) scale(1.22); opacity: .30; }
  100% { transform: translate(-25px, -90px) scale(1.08); opacity: .24; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .login-screen, .login-screen::before, .login-screen::after { animation: none; }
}

/* ---- RBAC permissions matrix ---- */
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--line); }
.tabs .tab {
  padding: 9px 16px; border: none; background: none; font: inherit; cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; margin-bottom: -2px;
}
.tabs .tab.active { color: var(--green); border-bottom-color: var(--green); }
.perm-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
.perm-table th, .perm-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-align: center; }
.perm-table th:first-child, .perm-table td.pmod { text-align: start; }
.perm-table thead th { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; color: var(--muted); }
.perm-table td.pmod { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.perm-table input[type="checkbox"] { width: 17px; height: 17px; cursor: pointer; accent-color: var(--green); }
.perm-table input.prow { width: 14px; height: 14px; accent-color: var(--muted); vertical-align: middle; }
.perm-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f7fafc; }
.pcell.overridden { background: var(--amber-l); border-radius: 6px; }
.pcell.na { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 4px, #f1f5f9 4px, #f1f5f9 8px); }

.cb-col { width: 26px; }   /* select-all column in the devices registry */

/* ---- list pagination ---- */
.pager { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 12px; margin-top: 14px; }
.pager .btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: default; }

/* ---- offline / sync status pill ---- */
.offline-status { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }
.offline-status.off { background: var(--red-l); color: var(--red); }
.offline-status.pend { background: var(--amber-l); color: var(--amber); }
.offline-status.hidden { display: none !important; }
/* Engineer materials balance: a depleted / over-used line. */
tr.bal-empty td { background: var(--red-l); color: var(--red); }

/* QR-coded devices: scan-to-inspect landing + label print preview. */
.scan-wrap { max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 6px; }
.scan-card { background: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 18px; }
.scan-head { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; }
.scan-ic { width: 54px; height: 54px; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; font-size: 26px; color: #fff; flex: none; }
.scan-title { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; }
.scan-now { margin: 14px 0; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--bg); border-radius: 10px; }
.scan-q { font-weight: 600; margin: 6px 0 8px; }
.scan-sts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
.scan-st { padding: 16px 10px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--c); color: var(--c);
  background: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: .12s; }
.scan-st:hover { background: var(--c); color: #fff; }
.scan-st:active { transform: scale(.97); }
.scan-note { width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; resize: vertical; }
.scan-geo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.scan-hist { margin-top: 18px; }
.scan-hist h3 { font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 8px; }
.scan-ev { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.scan-ev .dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: 5px; flex: none; }
.scan-ev .se-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.qr-mini { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.qr-mini-img { width: 84px; height: 84px; flex: none; }
.qr-mini-img svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

/* Selected status button on the scan screen. */
.scan-st.sel { background: var(--c); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15,118,110,.15); }

/* Per-type follow-up fields captured on a scan. */
.scan-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin: 4px 0 4px; }
.scan-f { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
/* Text/number/select boxes only — a tick box must keep its native size. */
.scan-f select, .scan-f input:not([type=checkbox]) { padding: 9px 10px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; }
/* A tick-list answer (what the trap caught) takes the whole row, two columns
   of boxes wide — a single column of twelve would bury the save button.
   Two class names deep so it beats the .opt-picks column layout below. */
.scan-f-wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.scan-f .scan-multi { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 10px;
  max-height: none; }
.scan-f .scan-multi .opt-pick { color: var(--ink); }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .scan-fields { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* What the last visit promised to do here — the first thing to read on
   arriving at the trap, so it sits above the status buttons in amber. */
.scan-promised { border: 1.5px solid #f59e0b; background: #fffbeb; border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 10px 12px; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
.scan-promised .sp-head { font-weight: 700; color: #92400e; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.scan-promised .sp-item { color: #78350f; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

/* "From the scans": the facts this visit's QR scans already recorded, shown
   under the report summary. Deliberately flat and quiet — it is evidence to
   read, not a field to fill, so it carries no input styling. A plain block, so
   a long fault list wraps on a phone instead of scrolling sideways. */

/* QR shown in the scan detail header + printable per-trap label. */
.scan-qr { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-inline-start: auto; }
.scan-qr-img { width: 76px; height: 76px; }
.scan-qr-img svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

/* Inline QR thumbnail in the Device QR Codes list (click to print that trap). */
.qr-td { width: 56px; }
.qr-cell { width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; line-height: 0; }
.qr-cell svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }
.qr-cell:hover { border-color: var(--green-d); }

/* Device QR registry toolbar + scan status lines. */
.dev-toolbar { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.dev-toolbar .spacer { flex: 1; }
.toolbar-select { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; font: inherit; background: #fff; }
.scan-now.ok-line { background: var(--green-l); color: var(--green-d); }
.scan-now.warn-line { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; }
.warn-line { color: #b45309; }

/* Visit device-coverage progress bar + pending rows. */
.cov-bar { background: var(--line); border-radius: 6px; height: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
.cov-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--green); transition: width .3s; }
tr.cov-pending td { background: #fff7ed; }
/* Device coverage is split per device type, each block scanning its own type. */
.cov-group { margin-top: 16px; }
.cov-head {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.cov-head h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

/* ===== Smart Dispatch board ===== */
.dispatch-board { display: flex; gap: 12px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }

/* THE MONTH AS A MATRIX — a row per engineer, a column per day (or the two
   swapped over; both layouts share these rules). Kept to a count and two
   times so a whole month reads at a glance and stays light enough for a
   phone.

   FIT MEANS LEGIBLE, NOT SHRUNK. The table is no longer stretched to the box
   — every day column is given the width its two lines need, and the box
   scrolls in both directions with the names and the dates pinned. A month
   that does not fit the screen is scrolled to, never squeezed into it. */
.dispatch-board.dg-month { display: block; overflow-x: visible; padding-bottom: 0; }
.dg-tools { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.dg-tools .dg-count { margin-inline-start: auto; }
.dg-wrap { overflow: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  max-height: min(74vh, 760px); border: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd); border-radius: 6px; }
/* Every table in the app is wrapped in a .table-scroll box at runtime (see
   installTableScroll). For the matrix that box would be a SECOND scroller
   inside this one — which is what stopped the month scrolling sideways and
   would unpin the header row — so here it is dissolved and .dg-wrap does the
   scrolling for both directions. */
.dg-wrap > .table-scroll { overflow: visible; max-width: none; width: max-content;
  min-width: 100%; }
table.dg { border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; width: max-content; min-width: 100%;
  font-size: 12px; }
table.dg th, table.dg td { border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e3e3); padding: 0; text-align: center; }
table.dg thead th { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 3; background: var(--panel, #f6f7f8);
  font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--line, #e3e3e3); }
table.dg tfoot td, table.dg tfoot th { position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 3;
  background: var(--panel, #f6f7f8); font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 4px 0;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--line, #e3e3e3); }
/* The pinned edge: the engineer (or the date), always in view however far the
   month is scrolled. */
table.dg th.dg-name { position: sticky; inset-inline-start: 0; z-index: 2;
  background: var(--panel, #f6f7f8); text-align: start; width: 168px; min-width: 168px;
  font-weight: 600; }
/* Padding is spelled out against thead/tfoot as well, because the shared
   `table.dg thead th` rule that zeroes it is the more specific of the two —
   and without this the engineer's total is printed hard up against the pinned
   column's edge, which is exactly the kind of half-legible number this whole
   change is about. */
table.dg th.dg-name, table.dg thead th.dg-name,
table.dg tfoot th.dg-name { padding: 5px 8px; }
th.dg-name.dg-corner, table.dg thead th.dg-name, table.dg tfoot th.dg-name { z-index: 5; }
.dg-nrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.dg-nm { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap; }
.dg-tot { flex: none; opacity: .6; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
th.dg-dayh .dg-nm b { font-size: 13px; margin-inline-end: 4px; }
/* The day heading: which weekday over which date, so a column is recognisable
   without counting across from the first. */
th.dg-d { width: 54px; min-width: 54px; line-height: 1.1; }
th.dg-d i { display: block; font-style: normal; font-size: 9px; opacity: .55; font-weight: 500; }
th.dg-d b { font-size: 12.5px; }
th.dg-d.dg-rest, td.dg-sum.dg-rest { background: var(--panel-2, #eceff1); }
tr.dg-rest-row th.dg-name { background: var(--panel-2, #eceff1); }
/* Names above, in the days-down layout — two short lines rather than one long
   one nobody can read. */
table.dg thead th.dg-eng-h { width: 76px; min-width: 76px; padding: 4px 3px; line-height: 1.15; }
th.dg-eng-h .dg-nm { display: block; white-space: normal; overflow: hidden; font-size: 10.5px; }
th.dg-eng-h .dg-tot { display: block; font-size: 10px; }
td.dg-cell { height: 38px; width: 54px; min-width: 54px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.15;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
table.dg-by-day td.dg-cell { width: 76px; min-width: 76px; }
td.dg-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0d7480); outline-offset: -2px; }
td.dg-cell b { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
/* The two hours are one LTR run even in Arabic — left to itself the mirror
   turns 08–16 into 16–08, which reads as a shift that ends before it starts. */
td.dg-cell .dg-t { display: block; font-size: 10px; opacity: .7; letter-spacing: -.02em;
  direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; }
td.dg-cell.l1 { background: rgba(13,116,128,.10); }
td.dg-cell.l2 { background: rgba(13,116,128,.20); }
td.dg-cell.l3 { background: rgba(13,116,128,.32); }
td.dg-cell.l4 { background: rgba(13,116,128,.45); }
td.dg-cell.dg-over { outline: 2px dashed var(--accent, #0d7480); outline-offset: -2px; }
td.dg-cell.dg-open { position: relative; outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0d7480);
  outline-offset: -2px; }

/* THE CELL, OPENED. Only the one you click fetches its visits, so the matrix
   costs nothing until it is asked. Each row is dragged on its own. */
.dg-pop { position: absolute; z-index: 20; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  min-width: 190px; max-width: 260px; background: var(--panel, #fff);
  border: 1px solid var(--line, #ccc); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); text-align: left; cursor: default; }
.dg-pop-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  font-size: 11px; opacity: .75; padding: 2px 4px 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.dg-v { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: baseline; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: grab; background: var(--panel-2, #f2f4f5); margin-top: 3px; }
.dg-v:hover { background: var(--hover, #e6eaec); }
.dg-v:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.dg-v-t { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; opacity: .7; flex: none; }
.dg-v-n { font-size: 11.5px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

/* A narrow screen gets a narrower name column and slightly tighter days — but
   it KEEPS the hours, which used to be dropped and left a bare number nobody
   could read a shift off. */
@media (max-width: 720px) { table.dg th.dg-name { width: 132px; min-width: 132px;
    font-size: 11.5px; padding: 5px 6px; }
  th.dg-d, td.dg-cell { width: 50px; min-width: 50px; }
  table.dg-by-day td.dg-cell, table.dg thead th.dg-eng-h { width: 72px; min-width: 72px; }
  .dg-pop { position: fixed; left: 8px; right: 8px; top: auto; bottom: 12px;
    transform: none; max-width: none; } }
.dp-col { flex: 0 0 240px; background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; }
.dp-col-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.dp-col-head strong { font-size: 13.5px; }
.dp-col-head .btn { margin-inline-start: auto; }
.dp-col-body { padding: 10px; min-height: 90px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; transition: background .15s; }
.dp-col-body.dp-over { background: rgba(31,116,214,.10); outline: 2px dashed var(--brand, #1f74d6); outline-offset: -4px; }
.dp-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 10px; cursor: grab; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.dp-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }
.dp-card.dragging { opacity: .45; }
.dp-card.b-scheduled { border-inline-start-color: #2563eb; }
.dp-card.b-in_progress { border-inline-start-color: #d97706; }
.dp-card.b-completed { border-inline-start-color: #16a34a; }
.dp-card.b-cancelled { border-inline-start-color: #dc2626; }
.dp-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.dp-time { font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; }
.dp-client { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }
.dp-empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; text-align: center; padding: 16px 6px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
/* Assigned work sitting outside the shift currently being dispatched. */
.dp-card.dp-out { background: #fffbeb; }
.dp-card.dp-out .dp-time { color: #b45309; }
.dp-shift-days { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green-d); background: var(--green-l); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 20px; }

/* ⇄ — the move a thumb can make, in place of a drag (phone only; see app.js). */
.dp-move {
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; color: var(--green-d);
  font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; border-radius: 9px;
  min-width: 38px; min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; flex: none;
}
.dp-move:active { background: var(--green-l); }
/* The sheet it opens: the board's own columns, one tappable row each. */
.mv-what { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 14px; }
.mv-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.mv-opt {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
  width: 100%; text-align: start; font: inherit; cursor: pointer;
  background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 13px 14px; min-height: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink);
}
.mv-opt:active { background: var(--green-l); border-color: var(--green); }
.mv-opt.mv-cur { border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green-l); }

/* SLA strip */
.sla-strip { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sla-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sla-chip { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px; }
.sla-chip.sla-overdue { background: #fde8e8; color: #b91c1c; }
.sla-chip.sla-due { background: #fef3e2; color: #b45309; }
.sla-chip.sla-ok { background: #e7f6ec; color: #15803d; }
.sla-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 8px 10px; margin-top: 6px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; }
.sla-row.sla-overdue { background: #fef2f2; border-inline-start: 3px solid #dc2626; }
.sla-row.sla-due { background: #fffbeb; border-inline-start: 3px solid #d97706; }

/* ===== Weekly shift roster ===== */
.sh-legend { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0 0 12px; }
.sh-chip {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: var(--sh, var(--green));
}
.sh-chip.off { color: var(--ink); }
.sh-chip .sh-time { font-weight: 500; opacity: .85; }
.sh-table { min-width: 860px; }
.sh-table th, .sh-table td { text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; }
.sh-table th.sh-agent { text-align: start; min-width: 170px; }
.sh-table th.sh-today { color: var(--green-d); }
.sh-cell { min-width: 96px; padding: 6px 4px; }
.sh-cell.sh-today { background: var(--green-l); }
.sh-cell.editable { cursor: pointer; }
.sh-cell.editable:hover { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: 8px; }
.sh-cell .sh-time { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.sh-cell .sh-empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 16px; }
.sh-load { display: inline-block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
/* Visits booked on a day the agent is off (or unrostered) — worth a second look. */
.sh-load.sh-clash { color: #b45309; font-weight: 700; }
.sh-total { background: var(--bg); }
/* A day can hold several blocks; they stack inside the cell. */
.sh-block { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.sh-block:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.sh-daytotal { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.sh-weekhours { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--green-d); }

/* Day editor: one row per block worked, hours typed by hand. */
.sh-rows-head, .sh-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1.1fr .9fr .9fr 1.2fr 48px 28px;
  gap: 8px; align-items: center;
}
.sh-rows-head { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.sh-row { margin-bottom: 8px; }
.sh-row input, .sh-row select { width: 100%; margin: 0; }
/* 24-hour time entry: fixed-width digits, and a clear flag when unparseable. */
input.hhmm { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .5px; }
input.hhmm.bad { border-color: var(--red); background: var(--red-l); }
.sh-rows-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.sh-daytotal-lg { font-weight: 700; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .sh-rows-head { display: none; }
  .sh-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
}
.sh-daybar { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sh-daybox { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 13px; }
tr.sh-retired { opacity: .55; }

/* Optimize-route preview modal */
.opt-summary { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.opt-summary > div { flex: 1; min-width: 100px; background: var(--bg); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; }
.opt-summary .opt-saved { background: #e7f6ec; }
.opt-summary strong { font-size: 18px; }
.opt-order { margin: 4px 0 14px; padding-inline-start: 22px; line-height: 1.9; }

/* ===== Agent "My Day" route list ===== */
.md-stop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--muted); border-radius: 11px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.md-stop.b-scheduled { border-inline-start-color: #2563eb; }
.md-stop.b-in_progress { border-inline-start-color: #d97706; }
.md-stop.b-completed { border-inline-start-color: #16a34a; }
.md-stop.b-cancelled { border-inline-start-color: #dc2626; opacity: .7; }
.md-seq { flex: 0 0 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--brand-grad); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.md-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.md-time { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.md-client { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
.md-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .md-stop { flex-wrap: wrap; } .md-actions { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; } }

/* Owner dashboard cockpit */
.cockpit-kpis { margin-top: 4px; }
.sc-trend { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; }
.sc-trend.up { color: var(--green); }
.sc-trend.down { color: var(--red); }
.util-table td.num, .util-table th.num { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
.util-table td { vertical-align: middle; }
.util-bar { height: 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e6edf3; overflow: hidden; min-width: 80px; }
.util-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--green)); }

/* ---- post-visit rating stars ---- */
.stars-input button { background: none; border: none; font-size: 30px; cursor: pointer; color: #f59e0b; padding: 2px 4px; }
.rated-stars { font-size: 24px; color: #f59e0b; letter-spacing: 3px; }

/* ======================================================================
   PHONE LAYOUT — html.pc-phone
   ======================================================================
   Set by index.html on a small touch screen only (the Android app and phone
   browsers alike); a desktop, a narrowed desktop window and a tablet never get
   it, so everything above this line keeps working exactly as it did.

   The rule this section follows: ONE COLUMN, ONE DIRECTION OF SCROLL, AT
   READABLE SIZE. An engineer standing in a kitchen with one thumb free should
   never pinch-zoom, never drag the page sideways, and never hunt for the save
   button. Data tables become stacked cards, forms become one column of large
   inputs, dialogs become full-screen sheets with the actions pinned to the
   bottom, and the sections a role works in every day sit on a bottom tab bar.
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* ---- foundation ---- */
html.pc-phone body { font-size: 15px; }
/* Nothing may push the page sideways — that is the whole point. */
html.pc-phone { overflow-x: hidden; }
/* Room at the foot for the tab bar (plus the gesture area on modern phones). */
html.pc-phone .view {
  max-width: none; padding: 12px 12px calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
html.pc-phone .app { min-height: 100dvh; }

/* ---- sidebar as a slide-over drawer ---- */
html.pc-phone .sidebar {
  position: fixed; top: 0; bottom: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; height: 100%;
  width: min(84vw, 300px); z-index: 60; box-shadow: 4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  transition: width .2s ease;
  /* The whole drawer is ONE scrolling box — logo, list and footer — so a finger
     that lands on the footer or the logo still moves the menu instead of
     finding nothing to scroll and handing the gesture to the page. `contain`
     stops the drawer's scroll from chaining into that page at either end,
     which is what used to scroll the dashboard behind the open drawer. */
  overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden; overscroll-behavior: contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; touch-action: pan-y;
}
html.pc-phone #nav { flex: 0 0 auto; overflow: visible; }
/* Short menu: keep the footer parked at the bottom (auto margin collapses to 0
   once the list is long enough to scroll). */
html.pc-phone .sidebar-foot { margin-top: auto; }
/* The open drawer always shows full labels (overrides the narrow-screen rail). */
html.pc-phone .nav-item { justify-content: flex-start; padding: 13px 16px; font-size: 15px; }
html.pc-phone .brand-sm { justify-content: flex-start; padding: 0 22px 18px; }
html.pc-phone .nav-item span:last-child, html.pc-phone .brand-sm span { display: inline; }
html.pc-phone .brand-logo-sm { width: 130px; }
html.pc-phone .sidebar-foot .user-box { display: block; }
html.pc-phone .sidebar-foot .link-btn { display: inline; text-align: start; padding: 9px 0; }
html.pc-phone .powered-sm { display: block; }
html.pc-phone #nav { padding: 10px; }
/* Closed = gone completely. */
html.pc-phone .app.nav-collapsed .sidebar { width: 0; padding: 0; box-shadow: none; }
/* Dim the page behind the open drawer (tap it to close — see app.js). */
html.pc-phone .app:not(.nav-collapsed)::after {
  content: ""; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(7,24,42,.45); z-index: 55;
  /* A drag on the dimmed page does nothing (a tap still closes the drawer) —
     without this the backdrop passes the gesture on to the document. */
  touch-action: none;
}
/* Belt and braces for the same thing: while the drawer is open the document
   itself is frozen (app.js adds .drawer-open and restores the scroll offset). */
html.pc-phone.drawer-open, html.pc-phone.drawer-open body { overflow: hidden; }

/* ---- bottom tab bar (phone only; hidden everywhere else) ---- */
.tabbar { display: none; }
html.pc-phone .tabbar {
  position: fixed; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 45;
  display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.98); border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.10);
  padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
}
html.pc-phone .tab-item {
  border: none; background: none; font: inherit; cursor: pointer;
  min-height: 58px; padding: 8px 3px 9px; display: flex; align-items: center;
  justify-content: center; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2;
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted);
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 transparent;
  /* Long section names must not widen the bar or wrap to three lines. */
  overflow: hidden; word-break: break-word;
}
html.pc-phone .tab-item.active {
  color: var(--green-d); background: var(--green-l);
  box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 var(--green);
}
html.pc-phone .tab-item:active { background: #eef4fb; }

/* ---- topbar: buttons stay tappable, search keeps the rest of the row ---- */
html.pc-phone .topbar { padding: 8px 10px; gap: 6px; }
/* THE ANDROID APP SWALLOWS THE TOP-LEFT CORNER. Up to and including APK 1.7 an
   invisible 56dp View sits over the corner (long-press it to change the server
   URL). Android gives a long-clickable view every touch that lands on it, so
   the ☰ underneath was dead IN THE APP ONLY — the same button works in a phone
   browser and on desktop. 1.8 drops that overlay and announces itself, and
   app.js only sets .pc-app-hotspot for builds that don't; until the new APK is
   installed, ☰ simply starts clear of the corner. NOT limited to .pc-phone: a
   WebView that never measured itself as a phone keeps the desktop layout, and
   the corner it cannot tap is exactly the same one. The width comes from
   syncCornerGuard() in app.js, which measures the page's own zoom. */
html.pc-app-hotspot .topbar .nav-toggle { margin-inline-start: var(--pc-corner, 62px); }

/* ---- "your app is out of date" bar (old APKs only) ---------------------- */
/* Sits at the foot of the screen, above the phone tab bar and clear of the
   home indicator. Shown only inside an APK that cannot answer appVersion() —
   the builds whose invisible corner view swallows the ☰ tap — and dismissed
   for the session, so it comes back tomorrow until the update is installed. */
.app-update {
  position: fixed; inset-inline: 8px; z-index: 52;
  bottom: calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: #0f172a; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(7, 24, 42, .35);
}
html.pc-phone .app-update { bottom: calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
.app-update span { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.app-update a {
  flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--green, #16a34a); color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
}
.app-update button {
  flex: 0 0 auto; background: none; border: none; color: #cbd5e1;
  font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 6px; line-height: 1;
}
html.pc-phone .topbar .icon-btn { min-width: 36px; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px; }
html.pc-phone .quick-search { min-width: 0; }
html.pc-phone .quick-search input { padding: 9px 14px 9px 34px; font-size: 16px; }
html[dir="rtl"].pc-phone .quick-search input { padding: 9px 34px 9px 14px; }
html.pc-phone .bell-menu { width: min(92vw, 340px); }

/* ---- headings, toolbars, stat cards ---- */
html.pc-phone .page-head { margin-bottom: 14px; gap: 10px; }
html.pc-phone .page-head h2 { font-size: 20px; }
/* Several pages build their button group as an inline `display:flex` with no
   wrap (month arrows + filters on the calendar, for one). Unwrapped, that row
   is ~500px wide and the browser zooms the WHOLE PAGE out to fit it — the very
   thing this layout exists to stop. Inline styles set display, never wrap, so
   this reaches them all. */
html.pc-phone .page-head > div { flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }
html.pc-phone .cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
html.pc-phone .stat-card { padding: 13px; gap: 10px; border-radius: 14px; }
html.pc-phone .stat-card .sc-ic { width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 18px; }
html.pc-phone .stat-card .v { font-size: 20px; }
html.pc-phone .stat-card .l { font-size: 11.5px; }
html.pc-phone .panel { padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; }
html.pc-phone .toolbar { gap: 8px; }
html.pc-phone .toolbar input, html.pc-phone .toolbar select,
html.pc-phone .toolbar-select { flex: 1 1 140px; min-height: 42px; font-size: 15px; }
/* Every tap target on a phone is a finger, not a mouse pointer. */
html.pc-phone .btn, html.pc-phone .btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 16px; }
html.pc-phone .btn.sm { min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 13px; }
html.pc-phone .link-btn { padding: 9px 0; }
html.pc-phone .tabs { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
html.pc-phone .kv { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
html.pc-phone .kv > div:nth-child(odd) {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .04em; margin-top: 10px;
}

/* ---- data tables become stacked cards ----------------------------------
   A table of 8 columns cannot be read on a 360px screen, and scrolling it
   sideways inside its own box means reading a row in two passes. So each row
   becomes a card: the first cell is its title, every other cell is labelled
   with its own column heading (stamped as data-label in app.js). Tables that
   are genuinely a matrix — the permission grid, the shift roster, the invoice
   line-item editor — keep the horizontal scroll box instead. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards { display: block; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards thead { display: none; }
/* th is in this list because totals rows are built from <th> — left as table
   cells they lay themselves out in a row and take the card sideways. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tr, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody th, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot th { display: block; width: auto; }
/* …and they must stop looking like column headings once they are card lines. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody th, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot th {
  background: none; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink);
}
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tr {
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 11px 13px; margin-bottom: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody tr:hover { background: #fff; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tr.clickable:active { background: var(--green-l); }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody th,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot th {
  border: 0; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500;
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 12px;
  align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between;
}
/* Lists put a quieter second line under a value ("Last service: …"). Give it a
   line of its own rather than letting it run on beside the value. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td > .small, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td > .muted {
  flex: 1 1 100%; text-align: end;
}
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td::before, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody th::before,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot th::before {
  content: attr(data-label); flex: 0 0 38%; color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
}
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards [data-label=""]::before,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards .pc-title::before,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards .pc-wide::before { content: none; }
/* The row's headline — the client, the invoice number, the device code. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards .pc-title {
  display: block; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 0 0 7px;
  margin-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}
/* Cells holding controls (row buttons, checkboxes, a QR thumbnail) get the
   full width rather than being squeezed into the value column. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards .pc-wide { display: block; padding-top: 8px; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards .pc-wide .row-actions { justify-content: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td:empty, html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tbody th:empty,
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards tfoot th:empty { display: none; }
/* Header cells that hold a control (select-all) survive as a plain strip. */
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards.pc-headkeep thead { display: block; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards.pc-headkeep thead tr {
  display: block; background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none;
  padding: 0 2px 8px; margin: 0;
}
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards.pc-headkeep th { display: none; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards.pc-headkeep th.pc-ctl {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: auto; background: none;
  font-size: 12px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 0;
}
/* Captions that only make sense once a column heading has become a card label. */
.pc-only { display: none; }
html.pc-phone .pc-only { display: inline; }
html.pc-phone table.pc-cards td.num { justify-content: space-between; }
/* Sub-tables (a contract's per-site breakdown) stay simple lists. */
html.pc-phone .ct-sites-detail td { padding: 0 0 8px; }

/* ---- forms: one column, large controls ---- */
html.pc-phone .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; }
/* Counters (lamps, cables, bait points…) stay two-up: short numeric fields in
   one column turn a report into a scrolling marathon. */
html.pc-phone .form-grid.compact { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
html.pc-phone .field label { font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
html.pc-phone .field input, html.pc-phone .field select, html.pc-phone .field textarea,
html.pc-phone .scan-f input:not([type=checkbox]), html.pc-phone .scan-f select, html.pc-phone .scan-note {
  /* 16px is the size below which mobile browsers zoom the page on focus. */
  font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 13px; border-radius: 12px; min-height: 46px;
}
html.pc-phone .field textarea { min-height: 108px; }
html.pc-phone .form-actions { flex-direction: row; gap: 10px; }
html.pc-phone .form-actions .btn { flex: 1; min-height: 48px; }

/* ---- dialogs become full-screen sheets ---- */
html.pc-phone .modal-overlay { padding: 0; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; }
html.pc-phone .modal {
  max-width: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 0;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
html.pc-phone .modal-head { padding: 14px 16px; flex: none; }
html.pc-phone .modal-head h3 { font-size: 16px; }
html.pc-phone .modal-body {
  padding: 16px 16px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
/* Save is always in the same place — pinned to the foot of the sheet, not
   somewhere below the fold of a long form. */
html.pc-phone .modal-body .form-actions {
  position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 2; background: #fff;
  margin: 18px -16px calc(-10px - env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  padding: 12px 16px calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

/* ---- login on a phone ----
   The card is a fixed 380px on desktop, which is wider than the screen once
   the page is laid out at the device's own width. */
html.pc-phone .login-screen { padding: 16px; }
html.pc-phone .login-card { width: 100%; max-width: 400px; padding: 26px 20px; border-radius: 18px; }
html.pc-phone .login-card h1 { font-size: 21px; }
html.pc-phone .login-card input { font-size: 16px; padding: 13px 14px; }
html.pc-phone .btn-primary { min-height: 50px; }

/* ---- screens with their own geometry ---- */
/* The month grid keeps its seven columns and scrolls as one piece, so the
   weekday header stays over the right column (see .cal-scroll in app.js). */
html.pc-phone .cal-scroll { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; padding-bottom: 4px; }
html.pc-phone .cal-scroll .cal-grid { min-width: 620px; }
html.pc-phone .cal-cell { min-height: 82px; }
/* THE DISPATCH BOARD ON A PHONE. On a desktop it is a row of 240px columns
   dragged into one another; on a phone neither half of that works — the row
   only ever showed one and a half columns, and HTML5 drag-and-drop does not
   fire on a touch screen at all, so the board could be looked at and not
   used. Here the columns STACK, full width, one direction of scroll like
   every other screen, and a visit is moved by tapping ⇄ (app.js). The month
   matrix stays a matrix — it is read across AND down — and scrolls inside its
   own box with the engineer's name pinned. */
html.pc-phone .dispatch-board { display: block; overflow-x: visible; padding-bottom: 0; }
html.pc-phone .dp-col { width: 100%; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 14px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-col-head { padding: 11px 12px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-col-head strong { font-size: 15px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-col-body { padding: 10px; min-height: 0; gap: 10px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-card { padding: 12px 13px; border-radius: 12px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-card-top { gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 5px; }
html.pc-phone .dp-client { font-size: 14.5px; }
/* An engineer with nothing booked is worth one quiet line, not a drop zone
   the size of a card — there is nothing to drop on a phone. */
html.pc-phone .dp-empty { padding: 7px 4px; border: 0; font-size: 12px; }
/* The filters: two to a row, at a size a finger hits. */
html.pc-phone .dp-filters { width: 100%; gap: 8px; }
/* Regrouped rather than reflowed: the four pickers two to a row, the day being
   dispatched on a line of its own, and the three ways of changing it on the
   last one. Four rows instead of six, and the same order in Arabic. */
html.pc-phone .dp-filters select {
  order: 1; flex: 1 1 44%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px;
}
html.pc-phone .dp-filters input[type=date] {
  order: 2; flex: 1 1 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px;
}
html.pc-phone .dp-filters .btn { order: 3; flex: 1 1 26%; }
/* The month matrix: bigger cells (a finger, not a pointer), and the day list
   it opens is a sheet at the foot of the screen (see the 720px rule above). */
html.pc-phone .dg-wrap { border-radius: 12px; max-height: 62vh; }
html.pc-phone td.dg-cell { height: 46px; }
html.pc-phone td.dg-cell b { font-size: 15px; }
html.pc-phone td.dg-cell .dg-t { font-size: 10px; }
html.pc-phone table.dg thead th { padding: 5px 2px; font-size: 12px; }
html.pc-phone th.dg-d b { font-size: 13px; }
html.pc-phone .dg-tools { gap: 8px; }
html.pc-phone .dg-tools .cal-modes { flex: 1 1 100%; }
html.pc-phone .dg-tools .cal-modes .btn { flex: 1 1 50%; min-height: 40px; }
html.pc-phone .dg-tools .dg-count { margin-inline-start: 0; }
html.pc-phone .dg-v { padding: 8px 8px; align-items: center; }
html.pc-phone .dg-v-n { font-size: 13.5px; flex: 1 1 auto; }
/* The day list opens as a sheet at the foot of the screen — which is exactly
   where the tab bar lives, so it has to sit ABOVE it (z-index 45) and stop
   short of it, or a long day's visits are dealt out under the tab bar and
   cannot be reached at all. */
html.pc-phone .dg-pop {
  padding: 10px; z-index: 50; bottom: calc(66px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  max-height: 50vh; overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
html.pc-phone .photo-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
/* A finger, not a pointer: both corner buttons on an attachment go up to 34px,
   and the comment line under it gets a proper row height. NOT scoped to
   .pc-phone: inside the APK a WebView that never measured itself as a phone
   keeps the desktop layout at 900px and zooms it down, and the small buttons
   land on the glass at less than half their size — which is why ✎ "was not
   there" in the app while it was obvious on a desktop. Any touch screen and any
   app build gets the big ones. */
html.pc-phone .photo-item .rm, html.pc-app .photo-item .rm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 15px; }
html.pc-phone .photo-item .ed, html.pc-app .photo-item .ed { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 16px; inset-inline-end: 47px; }
html.pc-phone .photo-item .cap, html.pc-app .photo-item .cap { padding: 10px 9px; min-height: 40px; }
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .photo-item .rm { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 15px; }
  .photo-item .ed { width: 34px; height: 34px; font-size: 16px; inset-inline-end: 47px; }
  .photo-item .cap { padding: 10px 9px; min-height: 40px; }
}
html.pc-phone .map-thumbs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
html.pc-phone .rdoc { padding: 16px 14px; border-radius: 12px; }
html.pc-phone .rdoc-meta { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
html.pc-phone .rdoc-sigs { flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
html.pc-phone .bar-row { grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr auto; gap: 8px; }
html.pc-phone .bar-val { min-width: 48px; }
html.pc-phone .scan-wrap { padding: 0; }
html.pc-phone .scan-st { padding: 18px 10px; font-size: 16px; }
/* The button that ends the visit sits above the tab bar, never under it. */
html.pc-phone .visit-save-bar {
  bottom: calc(58px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px;
}
html.pc-phone .visit-save-bar .btn { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 100%; }
html.pc-phone .toast {
  inset-inline: 12px; inset-inline-end: 12px; text-align: center;
  bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
html.pc-phone .pager { justify-content: center; }

/* --- In-app QR scanner (camera viewfinder in a modal) ------------------ */
.qr-scan .qr-view {
  position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #000;
  border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden;
}
.qr-scan video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
/* Aiming box — purely visual; the decoder reads the whole frame. */
.qr-scan .qr-frame {
  position: absolute; inset: 18% 18%; border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 100vmax rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
.qr-scan #qr-hint, .qr-scan #pf-camhint { margin-top: 10px; text-align: center; }
.qr-scan #qr-manual { text-transform: uppercase; }

/* --- Photos taken in-app, queued in the attachment dialog -------------- */
.shot-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 10px 0 0; }
.shot-strip:empty { margin: 0; }
.shot { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
.shot img {
  width: 74px; height: 74px; object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
}
.shot-x {
  position: absolute; top: -6px; inset-inline-end: -6px;
  width: 20px; height: 20px; line-height: 18px; padding: 0;
  border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer;
  background: #dc2626; color: #fff; font-size: 12px;
}

/* --- One comment per attachment, typed before the upload ---------------- */
/* Every picture gets its own words, so the dialog is a LIST of rows — a
   thumbnail, a comment box that starts empty, and the name the phone gave the
   file underneath it (shown so you can tell one photo from another, never used
   as the comment). .shot-x is reused for the remove button. */
.cap-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin: 10px 0 0; }
.cap-list:empty { margin: 0; }
.cap-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; position: relative; }
.cap-thumb { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 56px; height: 56px; display: flex;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--panel-2, #f8fafc); }
.cap-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.cap-icon { font-size: 22px; }
.cap-fields { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.cap-fields input { width: 100%; }
.cap-fields .small { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.cap-row .shot-x { position: static; flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* --- Export format picker (CSV / Excel / PDF) -------------------------- */
.export-opts { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.export-opts .exp-opt {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%;
  text-align: start; padding: 12px 14px; font-weight: 600;
}
.export-opts .exp-ic { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; }

/* --- Finance & Costs (owner) ------------------------------------------ */
.fin-head-btns { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.fin-head-btns select { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.fin-filters { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.fin-months td.num, .fin-months th.num,
.cat-table td.num,
#fin-recurring td.num, #fin-recurring th.num,
#fin-ledger td.num, #fin-ledger th.num { text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.fin-months { margin-top: 14px; }
.fin-months tfoot th { font-weight: 800; }
.num.pos { color: #16a34a; }   /* the profit line, in the chart's green */
.num.neg { color: var(--red); }
/* A stopped standing order stays on the list, greyed, so last year's totals
   can still be traced back to the bill that produced them. */
tr.row-off { opacity: .55; }
.cat-table td { padding: 6px 8px; vertical-align: middle; }
.cat-bar { width: 45%; }
.cat-bar span { display: block; height: 10px; border-radius: 6px; min-width: 2px; }
.fin-total td, .fin-total th { font-weight: 800; border-top: 2px solid var(--line); }
.fin-clients td.num, .fin-clients th.num { text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.fin-clients tbody tr { cursor: pointer; }
.fin-clients tbody tr:hover { background: var(--bg); }

/* Budget vs actual: the bar fills toward the allowance, and says so in colour
   before the number has to be read. */
.fin-budget td.num, .fin-budget th.num { text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.bud-bar { height: 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e6edf3; overflow: hidden; min-width: 90px; }
.bud-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; background: #16a34a; }
.bud-bar.near span { background: var(--amber); }
.bud-bar.over span { background: var(--red); }
.bud-form { width: 100%; }
.bud-form td, .bud-form th { padding: 5px 8px; }
.bud-form .bud-amount { width: 120px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.bud-form .bud-period { padding: 7px 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }

/* Cash flow forecast: a warning line, four figures, then the weeks. */
.cf-warn { background: var(--red-l); color: var(--red); padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 10px;
           font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cf-ok { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 10px;
         font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.cf-kpis { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.cf-kpis > div { flex: 1 1 150px; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid var(--line);
                 border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.cf-kpis .l { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
.cf-kpis .v { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; }
.fin-cf td.num, .fin-cf th.num { text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.fin-cf th { font-size: 12px; }

/* Foot of the visit page: the one button that ends the visit. It lives outside
   the report panel on purpose — an agent finishes the visit, not a form. */
.visit-save-bar {
  position: sticky; bottom: 0; z-index: 20; margin-top: 14px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
}
.visit-save-bar .vsb-note { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.visit-save-bar .btn { min-width: 160px; }

/* Repeating dates in the new-visit form. */
.vf-dates { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.vf-date-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
               padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: #f8fafc; }
.vf-date-row input, .vf-date-row select { padding: 7px 9px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
.vf-date-row .vf-time { width: 84px; }
.vf-date-row .vf-rm { margin-inline-start: auto; }
.vf-preview { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.row-actions { display: flex; gap: 6px; justify-content: flex-end; white-space: nowrap; }

/* ---- in-app document viewer ----
   A phone and the APK have no PDF reader, so uploaded files open inside a modal
   instead of a new tab (see openFileViewer in app.js). On a phone the modal is
   already a full-screen sheet with its own scroll; on desktop/tablet cap the
   height so a long manual scrolls inside the dialog rather than off the screen. */
.fileview { max-height: 72vh; overflow: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 10px; }
.fileview img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; }
.fileview-msg { padding: 26px 18px; text-align: center; }
.fileview-msg p { margin: 0 0 6px; }
.pdfview { padding: 6px; }
.pdfpage { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.pdfpage canvas { display: block; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); background: #fff; }
.pdfpage-n { text-align: center; padding: 4px 0 0; }
/* The sheet gives the viewer the whole screen: no inner cap, no side padding
   stealing width from the page image. */
html.pc-phone .modal-body.modal-flush { padding: 0; }
html.pc-phone .fileview { max-height: none; border-radius: 0; min-height: 100%; }

/* ---- calendar view switch (month | one day) ----
   The month grid is a 620px-wide scroller on a phone; the day view is the way
   to read a single day there without dragging sideways. */
.cal-modes { display: inline-flex; gap: 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.cal-modes .btn { border-radius: 0; border: none; box-shadow: none; }
/* A date opens its own day, so it has to look tappable. */
.cal-day[data-calday] { cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 6px; }
.cal-day[data-calday]:hover { background: var(--green-l); color: var(--ink); }
html.pc-phone .cal-day[data-calday] { padding: 3px 8px; }

/* New web code is waiting: ↻ reloads the app rather than re-fetching the screen,
   so it says so. */
#nav-refresh.has-update { position: relative; }
#nav-refresh.has-update::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; inset-inline-end: 3px;
  width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff;
}

/* Report condition / recommendation pick lists. Tick boxes rather than a
   dropdown: on a phone one tap each beats opening a menu per choice, and
   several choices per report is the normal case. */
.opt-picks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid #e3e8ec;
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; max-height: 260px; overflow-y: auto; background: #fff; }
/* Specificity matters here: these rows are <label>s inside a .field, and
   `.field label` (and its phone override) style them as FIELD CAPTIONS —
   display:block, bold, with a margin under each. That is why every choice sat
   on its own line with the words wrapped underneath the tick box and a gap
   below, and why a list of fifty was a screen and a half of scrolling. Three
   classes beat both of those rules. */
.opt-pick { padding: 7px 4px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 8px; }
.field .opt-picks .opt-pick { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px;
  margin: 0; font-weight: 400; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink); }
.field .opt-picks .opt-pick > span { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
.opt-pick:hover { background: #f6f9fc; }
.opt-pick input { margin-top: 3px; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.opt-legacy { margin-top: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #f6f9fc;
  color: #475569; font-size: 13px; }
/* The one tick on the Clear screen that reaches past the dates on show. It is
   meant to look nothing like the others — see clear_everything. */
.danger-pick { margin-top: 6px; border: 1px solid #fecaca; background: #fef2f2;
  color: #991b1b; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 10px; }
.danger-pick:hover { background: #fee2e2; }
/* THE PICK LISTS ON A PHONE. There are fifty conditions and fifty
   recommendations in the live book, and every one of them was drawn full
   height, one under the other, with the list free to grow as tall as it liked —
   so writing a report meant scrolling through a hundred rows to reach the
   Save button. Now each list is a box of its own that scrolls INSIDE the form
   (about half the screen), and the rows are tight: a 17px box and one line of
   text, ~32px a row instead of ~46, still a comfortable finger target because
   the whole row is the label. Applies inside the APK on any layout — a WebView
   that never measured itself as a phone has the same problem. */
html.pc-phone .opt-picks, html.pc-app .opt-picks {
  max-height: 46vh; overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  gap: 0; padding: 4px 8px;
}
html.pc-phone .opt-pick, html.pc-app .opt-pick { padding: 5px 4px; border-radius: 6px; }
html.pc-phone .field .opt-picks .opt-pick,
html.pc-app .field .opt-picks .opt-pick { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.3; }
html.pc-phone .opt-pick input, html.pc-app .opt-pick input { margin-top: 2px; }
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .opt-picks { max-height: 46vh; overflow-y: auto; gap: 0; padding: 4px 8px; }
  .opt-pick { padding: 5px 4px; }
  .field .opt-picks .opt-pick { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .opt-pick input { margin-top: 2px; }
}

/* TIGHTER STILL INSIDE THE APK (2026-09-06, his instruction). The app lays the
   CRM out wide and zooms it down, so a row that reads comfortably in a browser
   is a band of empty space on the tablet — with fifty conditions and fifty
   recommendations, the gaps alone were most of what he was scrolling past.
   Inside the APK a row is the tick box and its line of text and almost nothing
   else: ~19px instead of ~28, so half again as many choices fit in the same
   box. The whole row is still the label, so it stays a tap target. Web and
   phone-browser spacing is untouched — this is .pc-app only, as he asked. */
html.pc-app .opt-picks { gap: 0; padding: 3px 8px; }
html.pc-app .opt-pick { padding: 2px 4px; border-radius: 5px; }
html.pc-app .field .opt-picks .opt-pick {
  font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.25; gap: 7px;
}
/* AND THE TICK BOX ITSELF. On the phone layout `html.pc-phone .field input`
   catches these checkboxes and gives every one of them a text field's size —
   46px tall with 12px of padding — so a single-line choice was drawn 61px high.
   That, not the gaps, was most of the space he was scrolling past. Named with
   enough classes to beat that rule, and only inside the app. */
html.pc-app .field .opt-picks .opt-pick input {
  margin-top: 1px; padding: 0; min-height: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px;
  border-radius: 4px; flex: 0 0 auto;
}
/* The scan screens draw their multi-choice fields from the same box. */
html.pc-app .opt-picks.scan-multi { padding: 3px 8px; }

/* Areas on the dispatch board: who covers where, and the jobs that fall
   outside it. A flag, not a barrier — the drop is still allowed. */
.dp-area { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f766e; background: #ecfdf5;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 9px; }
.dp-card-area { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 3px; }
.dp-card-area.dp-off-area { color: #b45309; font-weight: 700; }
.dp-card.dp-off { border-inline-start: 3px solid #f59e0b; }

/* TEAM LEADERS. The patch a leader answers for, shown wherever their screens
   need to say "this, and no further" — the dashboard, My Team, and the amber
   variant for a leader nobody has given an area to yet. */
.lead-areas { margin: 0 0 14px; padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 10px; background: #ecfdf5;
  color: #0f766e; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
.lead-areas.warn-line { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; }
/* Multi-select of areas in the user form: checkboxes, not a multiple <select>,
   which is unusable on a phone and hides what is ticked. */
.chk-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 4px;
  border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; background: #fff;
  max-height: 220px; overflow-y: auto; }
.chk-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 3px; cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1.4; }
.chk-item:hover { background: #f6f9fc; border-radius: 8px; }
.chk-item input { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
html.pc-phone .chk-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-height: none; }
html.pc-phone .chk-item { padding: 9px 3px; }

/* FILLING AN AREA FROM ITS OWN ROW. One line per branch — name, company, and
   the area it is in NOW — because the question being answered is "where is
   this one today", and 179 of them have to be scannable. Single column: a
   two-column grid of long branch names wraps into mush. */
.ab-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; max-height: 46vh; }
.ab-row { justify-content: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
.ab-row .ab-name { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; }
.ab-row .ab-name strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.ab-tags { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-inline-start: auto; }
.ab-here { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #166534; background: #dcfce7;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 9px; }
.ab-booked { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #b45309; background: #fffbeb;
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.45; }
.ab-sum { margin: 10px 2px 0; }
.ab-sum-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.ab-delta { color: var(--green-d); font-size: 13px; }
#ab .toolbar { margin: 0 0 10px; }
html.pc-phone .ab-list { max-height: none; }
html.pc-phone .ab-tags { margin-inline-start: 0; }

/* The roster seen from the areas' side. An area with nobody on it is the whole
   point of the screen, so an empty day is tinted rather than left blank. */
.ar-cell { vertical-align: top; }
.ar-empty { background: #fffbeb; }
.ar-who { display: inline-block; background: #ecfdf5; color: #0f766e; border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 2px 9px; margin: 2px 3px 2px 0; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; }
tr.ar-loose td { background: #f8fafc; }
/* Gaps that stop work reaching a patch: a company with no branch, a branch with
   no area. Amber, because it is a setup task rather than a fault. */
.loc-gaps { background: #fffbeb; border-color: #fde68a; }
.loc-gaps .btn { margin: 0 6px 0 0; }

/* AVAILABILITY — the whole team on one grid. A worked day is tinted so the
   week reads at a glance, and the hours only appear once the day is ticked:
   most days here have no fixed times, and empty boxes would say otherwise. */
.av-table { width: 100%; }
.av-table th { white-space: nowrap; }
.av-table td { vertical-align: top; }
.av-day { min-width: 118px; }
.av-day.av-on { background: #ecfdf5; }
.av-hours { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 5px; }
.av-hours input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 12.5px; text-align: center; }
.av-areas { margin-top: 8px; }
.av-areas .chk-grid { max-height: 150px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); }
html.pc-phone .av-day { min-width: 96px; }
html.pc-phone .av-areas .chk-grid { max-height: none; }

/* The plan the one button proposes, before anybody agrees to it. The counts
   lead, and the amber one — work that could not be placed — is the number
   that means hire somebody or widen a window. */
.auto-summary { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin: 12px 0 10px; }
.sc-chip { background: #ecfdf5; color: #0f766e; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px;
  font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; }
.sc-chip.warn { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; }
.ar-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 0;
  line-height: 1.5; }

/* WHEN A BRANCH OPENS ITS DOORS. The mirror of the availability board, but for
