`````css
   the customer's side of the appointment: tick the days, and type hours only
   for the day that differs from the branch's usual window. */
.sd-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(132px, 1fr)); gap: 5px;
  border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; background: #fff; }
.sd-day { display: block; padding: 6px 7px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; line-height: 1.4; }
.sd-day:hover { background: #f6f9fc; }
.sd-day.sd-on { background: #ecfdf5; }
.sd-tick { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.sd-tick input { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.sd-hours { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 5px; }
.sd-hours input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 12.5px; text-align: center; }
html.pc-phone .sd-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(112px, 1fr)); }

/* The same fact read back on the Locations list, where the office looks at the
   whole book at once. A day carrying its own hours is starred — the exception
   is what wants spotting, not the rule. */
.sd-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3px; margin-top: 3px; }
.sd-chip { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; background: #f1f5f9;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; }
.sd-chip.sd-chip-own { color: #0f766e; background: #ecfdf5; }
/* The night shift (22:00–02:00): the window is real, but only its hours before
   midnight land on the day the visit is due. */
.sd-night { cursor: help; }
/* A round that ends after midnight. Small, but it is the difference between
   "22:00–01:30" read as three and a half hours and read as minus twenty. */
.next-day { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #4a52b8; background: #eef0fd;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 7px; margin-inline-start: 4px; }

/* BACKUP & RESTORE. The taking half is ordinary; the restoring half replaces
   the whole business and is dressed to say so — red rail, red button, and a
   word to type before it will move. */
.bk-panel h3, .bk-danger h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 16px; }
.bk-opt { align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.bk-opt:first-of-type { border-top: 0; }
.bk-opt .small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; }
.bk-sub { margin: 2px 0 6px; padding-inline-start: 28px; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
/* The parts checklist. Two columns on a desk, one on a phone — a dozen choices
   in a single column is a scroll, and the point is to see them all at once. */
.bk-parts { margin: 2px 0 8px; padding-inline-start: 28px; display: grid; gap: 4px;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); }
.bk-parts .chk-item { align-items: baseline; }
.bk-parts .small { display: block; }
.bk-parts-all { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: 4px; }
html.pc-phone .bk-parts { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.bk-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.bk-ready { background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #065f46;
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 13px; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.bk-danger { border-inline-start: 3px solid #dc2626; }
.bk-danger p { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.bk-restore { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-top: 8px; }
.bk-confirm { max-width: 190px; letter-spacing: .08em; font-weight: 700; }
.bk-bar { height: 10px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden;
  margin: 12px 0 6px; }
.bk-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #dc2626); }
html.pc-phone .bk-restore { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
html.pc-phone .bk-confirm { max-width: none; }

/* Branches the plan could not fully serve. Not a failure of the planner — a
   customer asking for more visits than the days they will open, which only the
   office can settle. */
.auto-capped { background: #fffbeb; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 13px; margin: 12px 0 4px; color: #92400e; }
.auto-capped ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-inline-start: 20px; }
.auto-capped li { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }

/* A round the planner had to bend to keep a customer's visit. NOT a warning
   colour — the visit was saved, which is what the office asked for; it is
   information, and the office decides whether the longer day is worth it. */
.auto-bent { background: #eff6ff; border: 1px solid #bfdbfe; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 13px; margin: 12px 0 4px; color: #1e40af; }
.auto-bent ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-inline-start: 20px; }
.auto-bent li { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; }

/* The way back from one press of the button. Deliberately sits above the
   roster grid, not buried in a menu: the moment somebody wants to undo an
   applied plan is the moment right after applying it. */
.run-strip { border-inline-start: 3px solid #0f766e; }
.run-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 6px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); margin-top: 6px; }
.run-row:first-of-type { border-top: 0; }
.run-row.run-new { background: #ecfdf5; border-radius: 8px; padding-inline: 8px; }
html.pc-phone .run-row { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }

/* MISSING OWED VISITS. A branch below the number its cycle owes for the month,
   because a visit was deleted by hand and never replaced. Amber, not the
   teal of the undo strip: this one is asking for something to be done. */
.gap-strip { border-inline-start-color: #b45309;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.gap-count { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #9a3412; }
.bs-gap { display: inline-block; margin-inline-start: 4px; font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700; color: #9a3412; white-space: nowrap; cursor: help; }

/* THE BRANCH SCHEDULE BOARD. Same bones as the availability board — the office
   reads one screen and saves once — but with ~150 rows instead of 14, so the
   day cells stay narrow and the table scrolls in its own box. */
/* The board scrolls in ITS OWN box now. It used to overflow the panel and take
   the whole page sideways with it, so the only scrollbar was the window's —
   parked under two hundred rows, which is why Thursday and Friday felt out of
   reach. Rail on top, table below, same scroll position. */
.bs-wrap { padding-top: 12px; }
/* Tall enough for a real scrollbar to be drawn in: at content height the bar
   had nowhere to render and the rail was a 1px line nobody could grab. */
.bs-rail { overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; height: 14px; }
.bs-rail-inner { height: 1px; }

.bs-rail::-webkit-scrollbar, .bs-wrap .table-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 12px; }
.bs-rail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .bs-wrap .table-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #c7d2de; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid #fff; }
.bs-rail::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover,
.bs-wrap .table-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #a9b8c9; }
.bs-hint { margin-top: 8px; }

/* Anything carrying an UPLOADED document's own words. Chrome and the phone's
   WebView translate whatever text they can reach on a page; a manual, a licence
   or a safety sheet must read exactly as it was written, whatever language that
   is. (The PDF pages themselves are drawn on a canvas and were never at risk —
   this is for the name, the description and the fallback text around them.) */
.notranslate { unicode-bidi: plaintext; }
.bs-table { width: 100%; }
/* THE BRANCH NAME STAYS PUT. Halfway across a 1600px table every row looks the
   same; frozen, the name is always the thing you are editing against. The
   shadow only appears once there is something hidden behind it. */
.bs-table th:first-child, .bs-table td:first-child {
  position: sticky; inset-inline-start: 0; z-index: 2; background: #fff; }
.bs-table thead th:first-child { z-index: 3; background: #f8fafc; }
.bs-scrolled .bs-table th:first-child, .bs-scrolled .bs-table td:first-child {
  /* only once something is actually hidden behind it */
  box-shadow: 6px 0 8px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, .28); }
[dir="rtl"] .bs-scrolled .bs-table th:first-child,
[dir="rtl"] .bs-scrolled .bs-table td:first-child {
  box-shadow: -6px 0 8px -6px rgba(15, 23, 42, .28); }
.bs-table th { white-space: nowrap; }
.bs-table td { vertical-align: top; }
.bs-table input[type=text], .bs-table input[type=number], .bs-table select {
  width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.bs-table td:first-child { min-width: 160px; }
/* The AREA column. Its select is width:100% with min-width:0 so the day cells
   keep their room — which let the column collapse to a sliver, and the office
   could not read which area a branch was in without opening the dropdown. The
   column gets a floor wide enough for a real area name in either language. */
.bs-table th:nth-child(2), .bs-table td:nth-child(2) { min-width: 200px; }
.bs-table .bs-area { min-width: 180px; }
/* The two window columns need to show HH:MM without clipping either. */
.bs-table th:nth-child(3), .bs-table td:nth-child(3),
.bs-table th:nth-child(4), .bs-table td:nth-child(4) { min-width: 86px; }
/* HOW OFTEN: a number and the unit it is counted in, side by side. The office
   reads some branches in weeks and some in months, and the unit has to be
   visible on the row rather than remembered — a "2" that could mean either is
   the ambiguity this pair exists to remove. Wide enough for "per month" in
   both languages. */
.freq-pair { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }
.freq-pair input[type=number] { flex: 0 0 52px; text-align: center; }
.freq-pair select { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.bs-table th:nth-child(5), .bs-table td:nth-child(5) { min-width: 150px; }
html.pc-phone .bs-table th:nth-child(5),
html.pc-phone .bs-table td:nth-child(5) { min-width: 132px; }
.bs-day { min-width: 104px; }
.bs-day.bs-on { background: #ecfdf5; }
.bs-hours { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin-top: 4px; }
.bs-hours input { text-align: center; }
html.pc-phone .bs-day { min-width: 92px; }
html.pc-phone .bs-table th:nth-child(2), html.pc-phone .bs-table td:nth-child(2) { min-width: 150px; }
html.pc-phone .bs-table .bs-area { min-width: 138px; }

/* Work the plan could not book, grouped by what to do about it. Sits above the
   day-by-day table because the office needs to decide whether to accept the
   plan BEFORE reading it. */
.auto-unplaced { background: #fff7ed; border: 1px solid #fed7aa; border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 13px; margin: 10px 0; color: #9a3412; }
.un-group { margin-top: 8px; }
.un-why { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.5; }
.auto-unplaced .muted { color: #b45309; }

/* THE SAME WORK, ONCE THE PLAN HAS BEEN APPLIED — the preview's amber block is
   a warning, this is a worklist somebody actually clears. A line that has been
   dealt with stays on the list, greyed: the office wants to see the shortfall
   shrinking, not rows disappearing under their hands. */
.btn.warn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(217,119,6,.25); }
.up-group { margin-top: 14px; }
.up-why { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #9a3412; background: #fff7ed;
  border: 1px solid #fed7aa; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
.up-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.up-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.up-when { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); min-width: 92px; }
.up-what { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.up-branch { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; }
.up-what .small { display: block; }
.up-act { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.up-tag { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.up-tag.ok { color: #0f766e; }
.up-done { opacity: .55; }
html.pc-phone .up-row { flex-wrap: wrap; }
html.pc-phone .up-when { min-width: 0; }

/* Can the book be serviced? Read while the office is still typing it. */
.cap-panel { border-inline-start: 3px solid #0f766e; }
.cap-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.cap-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 3px 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cap-name { min-width: 130px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; }
.cap-bar { flex: 1; min-width: 120px; height: 9px; background: #eef2f6;
  border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.cap-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; }
.cap-ok { background: #16a34a; } .cap-tight { background: #f59e0b; } .cap-over { background: #dc2626; }
html.pc-phone .cap-name { min-width: 100%; }

/* The answer to the customer's first question, stated rather than implied. */
.next-visit { background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #0f766e;
  border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 13px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

/* THE PIPELINE BOARD. Grouped in the order work flows, so a stall reads as a
   place in the chain rather than a number on its own. */
.pipe-group { margin-bottom: 16px; }
.pipe-group h3 { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em;
  color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 7px; }
.pipe-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 9px; }
.pipe-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-start;
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px;
  cursor: pointer; text-align: start; font: inherit; }
.pipe-card:hover { border-color: #94a3b8; }
.pipe-n { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: #64748b; }
.pipe-lbl { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }
.pipe-card.pipe-stuck { background: #fffbeb; border-color: #fde68a; }
.pipe-card.pipe-stuck .pipe-n { color: #b45309; }

/* MARKETING TARGETS. The commission on a contract is money a real person is
   counting on, so the row that has stopped earning is drawn as stopped —
   greyed, with what it would still be paying spelled out beside it. */
.mkt-rate { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.mkt-bar { display: inline-block; width: 110px; height: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: #e6edf3; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: middle; margin-inline-end: 6px; }
.mkt-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 6px; }
.mkt-bar i.mkt-on { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan), var(--green)); }
.mkt-bar i.mkt-near { background: #f59e0b; }
.mkt-bar i.mkt-off { background: #94a3b8; }
.mkt-up { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; }
tr.mkt-dead td { opacity: .62; }
.mkt-target-panel .mkt-bar { width: 100%; height: 12px; }
.mkt-target-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.b-paused { background: var(--amber-l); color: var(--amber); }
.b-ended { background: var(--red-l); color: var(--red); }

/* THE AVAILABILITY BOARD'S AREAS, GROUPED BY ZONE. Twenty-eight loose ticks
   per engineer is what made this board a chore; the zone heading gives the
   office one gesture for a whole side of the city, and a rule between groups
   so the eye can find the one it wants. */
.av-zonegrp { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e8f0); padding-top: 4px; margin-top: 4px; }
.av-zonegrp:first-child { border-top: 0; margin-top: 0; }
.av-zonehead { margin-bottom: 2px; }
.av-zonehead strong { font-size: 12.5px; }
/* WHICH DAYS HE WORKS A PATCH — the exception, not the rule, so it is small,
   indented under its area, and only shown once the area is ticked. */
.av-areaitem { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; }
.av-areadays { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2px; margin-inline-start: 18px; }
.av-areadays label {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px;
  font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted, #64748b); white-space: nowrap;
}
.av-areadays input { width: 11px; height: 11px; margin: 0; }


/* FIXED POSTS ON THE ROSTER. Hours already sold to one site — never a visit,
   so they read as their own kind of line and are never counted among them. */
.ar-post { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 3px 0; }
.badge.b-post { background: rgba(13,116,128,.14); color: #0a5a64; border: 1px solid rgba(13,116,128,.35); }
.badge.b-danger { background: rgba(168,50,44,.12); color: #a8322c; border: 1px solid rgba(168,50,44,.45); }
.ar-uncovered { background: rgba(168,50,44,.07); border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 6px; }
.auto-uncovered { border-left: 3px solid #a8322c; }
.sc-chip.danger { background: rgba(168,50,44,.12); color: #a8322c; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .badge.b-post { background: rgba(63,195,209,.16); color: #7fd9e3; border-color: rgba(63,195,209,.4); }
  .badge.b-danger { background: rgba(239,125,120,.16); color: #ef7d78; border-color: rgba(239,125,120,.45); }
  .ar-uncovered { background: rgba(239,125,120,.10); }
  .sc-chip.danger { background: rgba(239,125,120,.16); color: #ef7d78; }
}

/* THE MENU HE CUT DOWN. Anything he moved is under "More" — still one click
   away, because a menu you cannot get back from is a lost feature. */
.nav-more { margin-top: 2px; }
.nav-more > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 9px 14px;
  color: var(--muted, #7a8a90); font-size: 13px; user-select: none; }
.nav-more > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.nav-more > summary::before { content: "▸"; display: inline-block; width: 12px;
  transition: transform .12s ease; }
.nav-more[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.nav-more > summary .n { opacity: .6; font-size: 11px; }
.nav-more .nav-item { padding-left: 26px; }
.nav-customise { margin-top: 6px; opacity: .75; font-size: 13px; }
.nav-customise:hover { opacity: 1; }

/* ---- WHO CAN TAKE THIS VISIT ------------------------------------------- */
/* Opened under the branch it is about, in the worklist, and as a dialog from
   the plan preview. Read top to bottom: the man, why he is a good idea, the
   gap, and the call either side of it with how far away that is. */
.un-names { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px; }
.un-branch {
  border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; background: #fff; border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 4px 11px; font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer; text-align: start;
}
.un-branch:hover { background: #f6f9fc; border-color: #cbd5e1; }
.un-branch.open { background: var(--green-l, #ecfdf5); border-color: #99f6e4; font-weight: 600; }
.up-who { margin: 0 0 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; }
.wct-men { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.wct-man { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 11px; }
.wct-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.wct-why { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #0f766e; background: #ecfdf5;
  border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 9px; }
.wct-km { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.wct-slot { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; margin: 4px 0 2px; }
.wct-side { font-size: 12.5px; color: #475569; }
.wct-act { margin-top: 7px; }
.wct-note { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fffbeb; font-size: 13px; }
.wct-blocked { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.wct-blocked summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
.wct-no { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; padding: 3px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f6; }
/* On a phone the two halves of a "why not" line stack rather than squeeze. */
html.pc-phone .wct-no, html.pc-app .wct-no { flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }

/* ---- branches the book asks too much of -------------------------------- */
/* Every one of these is fixed in the branch's own record, so the row reads as
   a note to the office: what it asks, what fits, and the number to type. */
.oa-row { border: 1px solid #e3e8ec; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px;
  margin-bottom: 8px; background: #fff; }
.oa-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.oa-why { font-size: 13.5px; color: #b45309; margin: 5px 0 2px; }
.oa-fix { font-size: 13px; color: #0f766e; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.oa-act { margin-top: 7px; }
`````
